edits.new_string:
local joined = false
-- (2026-10-22 owner: the reward needs the group only) the SERVER's group check decides (FreeGift.InGroup runs the same
-- inGroup() as the claim, uncached), so the UI and the claim always agree; IsInGroup (cached per session) is the fallback
local InGroup = folder:WaitForChild("InGroup", 10)
local function checkGroup()
	if InGroup then
		local ok, member = pcall(InGroup.InvokeServer, InGroup)
		if ok and type(member) == "boolean" then joined = member return end
	end
	local ok, member = pcall(player.IsInGroup, player, GROUP_ID)
	if ok and member then joined = true end
end
